data.name: Khairiyah
data.gender_notes: Khairiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Khair' which means 'good'. Khairiyah means someone who is generous and beneficent. The name Khairiyah carries the meaning “Generous, Beneficent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khairiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, beneficent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Surah Al-Fajr, Allah SWT mentions that the righteous will be given a drink from a fountain named Kauthar by the Prophet Muhammad SAW, which is also a name of one of the Surahs. Khairiyah, being derived from Khair, is a reflection of this divine generosity.
data.etymology: Khairiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Beneficent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khairiyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: خيرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الخير والصلاح والفلاح
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خيرية هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل 'خير' الذي يعني الخير والصلاح والفلاح. يستخدم هذا الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يتميز بالخير والصلاح في أفعاله وسلوكه. ورد ذكر مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مما يزيد من أهميته في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: خیرية
in_urdu.meaning: خیر و صلاح اور فلاح کا प्रतीक
in_urdu.long_meaning: خیرية ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو 'خیر' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خیر، صلاح اور فلاح۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے افعال اور سلوک میں خیر اور صلاح سے جڑے ہوئے ہیں۔ عربی मूल کے اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں اس کے روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کی وجہ سے کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खैरियह
in_hindi.meaning: खैर और صلاح का प्रतीक नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: खैरियह एक मादा नाम है जो 'खैर' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है खैर, صلاح और फलाह। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने कार्यों और व्यवहार में खैर और صلاح से जुड़े होते हैं। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसकी आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व के कारण किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: خیريہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: خیريہ یو مؤنث نوم دی چی د 'خیر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی معنی یی خیر، صلاح او فلاح ده. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چی د دوی په کړو او چلند کې خیر او صلاح سره تړلي دي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د هغې د مذهبي او کلتوري اهميت له امله کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Khairiyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'khair', meaning goodness, righteousness, and prosperity
in_english.long_meaning: Khairiyah is a feminine name derived from the Arabic root 'khair', which means goodness, righteousness, and prosperity. This name signifies an individual characterized by good deeds and behavior. The root 'khair' is mentioned in the Quran, enhancing its significance in Islamic culture. Historically, the name Khairiyah has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing positive attributes and spiritual values. It reflects the importance of leading a virtuous life and spreading goodness.

data.cultural_impact: Khairiyah is a beautiful name that holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world. It reflects the core Islamic values of generosity, kindness, and goodwill towards others. Naming a child with this name is considered an inspiration and a reminder to be benevolent and to spread positivity, happiness, and kindness in the world.
data.spiritual_significance: Khairiyah holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam. It signifies the essence of God's divine nature, which is pure and good. The name is a reminder of the wisdom in the Quran that states, "All bounties and all goodness are from Allah." (2:286) The name Khairiyah is a constant reminder to seek goodness, pleasance Allah, and to be generous towards others, reflecting the qualities of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was known for his kindness and generosity to all.
